answer: Proof of Stake mechanisms require agents to bond capital to act as a jetty for network security, preventing an unbounded spiral of identity generation. By forcing entities to incur a financial cost proportional to their influence, the system ensures that the orchard of available resources remains exclusive to stakeholders. An attacker must acquire a majority of the circulating supply, imposing a prohibitively expensive barrier that renders large-scale Sybil attacks economically irrational.
